# BanglaEV

> BanglaEV is Bangladesh's independent electric-vehicle guide — prices, specs, reviews, comparisons, charging information and news for BYD, MG, Hyundai, Kia, Tesla, Neta and Zeekr EVs available locally. Content is published in Bengali (default) with English alternates.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of EVs available in Bangladesh with featured models and latest news.
- [All Models](/models): Browse every EV on sale in Bangladesh with price, range and specs.
- [BYD](/byd): Full BYD lineup in Bangladesh — Atto 3, Seal, Sealion, Dolphin and more.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of up to three EVs across brands.
- [Cost Calculator](/calculator): Estimate monthly and five-year savings of an EV vs petrol.
- [Charging](/charging): Guide to home and public EV charging in Bangladesh, including BERC tariff.
- [News](/news): Latest EV, policy and charging news from Bangladesh.
- [About](/about): About BanglaEV and partnership contact.
